review.notes: All 15 targets inspected on finished source and regenerated contour context sheet. Complete fish fins, both flying-bird wings, shell latch, anchor ring, rope loops/tails, bottle cap, tool ring and jar occlusion edge corrected. Exposed otter replaced by the basket woven-fish skeleton (stable ID retained); skeleton ribs and negative spaces traced. Bow target is the distinct upper wave scroll. Geometry and 11/4 quota valid. Authored difficulty estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration pending.

targets.name: Carved fish in the roof bracket
targets.concealment: The relief follows the same weathered wood grain and curling plant shapes as the roof bracket.

targets.name: Flying bird carved in the roof beam
targets.concealment: The small bird is carved flat into the roof timber and matches the lines of the adjacent beam.

targets.name: Scallop shell on the door latch
targets.concealment: A brass shell-shaped handle is incorporated into the aged metal latch on a similarly colored post.

targets.name: Anchor carved in the bracket
targets.concealment: The anchor is a shallow same-material motif amid carved reeds and shell patterns.

targets.name: Looped rope knot
targets.concealment: The decorative knot shares the color and twist of surrounding suspended ropes.

targets.name: Woven fish skeleton on the basket
targets.concealment: The fish bones are woven in the same fiber as the basket, nested among a dense mesh of similar curves and partly blended into the rim.

targets.name: Upper wave scroll on the boat
targets.concealment: The narrow raised scroll blends into identically weathered boat trim and repeats the adjacent lower wave carving.

targets.name: Netted green flask
targets.concealment: The small green glass flask is recessed under nets and shares the color of foliage and river reflections.

targets.name: Ring-topped metal hand tool
targets.concealment: Its narrow iron shaft follows plank seams and shares the color and line direction of nearby dark hardware.

targets.name: Small capped glass bottle
targets.concealment: The dark bottle is recessed on the tool bench; reflected wood tones blend its body into the weathered planks behind it.

targets.name: Blue fish painted on the jug
targets.concealment: A blue fish motif is embedded among painted reed patterns on a pot partly screened by equipment.

targets.name: Blue-ribbon straw hat
targets.concealment: The hat is clearly separated on the jetty ledge.

targets.name: Closed brass spyglass
targets.concealment: A large spyglass lies openly across the foreground planks.

targets.name: Pink scallop shell
targets.concealment: The pink shell stands out clearly against the gray jetty.

targets.name: Jar of river shells
targets.concealment: A broad glass jar displays pale shells on the upper shelf.
